host.description: Network interface to bind the OmniDB web server to (e.g., '127.0.0.1' for localhost only, or '0.0.0.0' for all interfaces).

port.description: TCP port on which the OmniDB server listens for HTTP(S) requests.

db_path.description: Absolute path to the SQLite database file that stores OmniDB’s internal metadata (users, sessions, preferences).

secret_key.description: Cryptographically strong secret used for signing sessions and encrypting sensitive data. Must be at least 32 characters long.

ssl_enabled.description: Enable HTTPS by serving TLS-encrypted traffic. Requires valid SSL certificate and key files.

ssl_cert.description: Path to the SSL certificate file (PEM format) used for HTTPS.

ssl_key.description: Path to the SSL private key file (PEM format) corresponding to the certificate.

workers.description: Number of worker processes to spawn. Set to 0 for automatic detection based on CPU cores.

debug.description: Enable verbose debugging mode (include stack traces and internal logs). Not recommended for production.

session_timeout.description: Session inactivity timeout in seconds (e.g., 1800 = 30 minutes). After this period, the session is invalidated.

enable_local_auth.description: Enable OmniDB’s built-in user authentication system. Disable only if using external auth (e.g., LDAP via reverse proxy).

max_connections_per_db.description: Maximum number of simultaneous database connections OmniDB will maintain per database (prevents connection exhaustion).

allowed_origins.description: List of allowed CORS origins (domains) for cross-origin API requests. Leave empty to allow all (not recommended in production).

log_level.description: Minimum logging level: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, or CRITICAL.

log_path.description: Absolute path to the main application log file.

db_templates.description: List of default database connection templates shown in the OmniDB UI for quick connection creation. Each entry defines connection defaults.

name.description: Internal identifier for the template (e.g., 'postgres', 'mysql'). Must be unique.

title.description: Human-readable name shown in the OmniDB UI.

type.description: Database engine type (must match OmniDB's supported engines).

host.description: Database server hostname or IP address.

db_name.description: Default database name. For SQLite, this should be a full file path.

password.description: Default password (not stored in templates; omit for security). Use only in secure dev/test configs.

use_ssh_tunnel.description: Enable SSH tunneling to access a database behind a firewall.

ssh_host.description: SSH bastion host address (required if SSH tunneling is enabled).

ssh_key.description: Path to SSH private key file (PEM format) for authenticating the tunnel.
